facts.fact: The Interior Ministry's own account of its campaign launch at Tahoua on 11 August 2026 lists, among the reforms it is carrying out, the computerisation of communes for civil status and the putting into service of a Registre National d'État Civil (RNEC); the campaign is run with the WURI project's support.

As at 11 August 2026 the Interior Ministry names computerisation of communes for civil status and the putting into service of the RNEC as reforms under way with the campaign, without saying how many communes are computerised or that the RNEC is in service.
